title: % Off and $ Off take each range off Default's price in that range
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, two ranges: $0.00 to $100.00 Default 50% markup, $100.01 and up Default 20% markup; tier A % Off 10 then 5; tier B $ Off 15 then 20.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Type 100 in the Price Part Simulator's Part Cost.
  4. Type 200 in the Part Cost.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • Default shows $150.00 ($100.00 × 1.50).
  • Tier A shows $135.00 ($150.00 × 0.90).
  • Tier B shows $135.00 ($150.00 − $15.00).

Step 4:

  • Default shows $240.00 ($200.00 × 1.20).
  • Tier A shows $228.00 ($240.00 × 0.95).
  • Tier B shows $220.00 ($240.00 − $20.00).
